_source.from: a single photograph, front three-quarter view from the forecourt
_source.read_by: written by hand from the photo; the same fields a vision model would fill
_source.what_it_is_not: This is a TYPE, not an address. It is not a survey of the building photographed, no institution is identified, and no name or emblem from the photograph is reproduced. A stylized, licence-clean stand-in in the manner of the other models here.

confidence.depthM: GUESSED. Only the façade and a sliver of the end wall are visible; 14 m is a normal double-loaded corridor block. Could be anything from 12 to 18.
confidence.widthM: estimated from the bay rhythm against storey height, ±15%
confidence.bays: counted from the façade at an oblique angle — the far end is foreshortened, so ±2
confidence.rear: entirely unseen. Modelled plain on purpose rather than invented.
confidence.roof pitch: read from the gable end; the eave line is partly hidden by trees
confidence.emblem and lettering: present on the real pediment and deliberately NOT reproduced — a blank board and a plain disc stand in for them
confidence.site: The forecourt, lawn and tree rows are read from the photograph's foreground: young staked saplings about a season old, a kerbed lawn strip, wide pale paving. Positions are plausible, not surveyed.

site._no_palms: Palms are deliberately absent. A frond is a folded ribbon along a curve and the baked-glb vocabulary here only has cones — three attempts produced something that read as a spiky star, which is worse than no palm. CamboVerse already renders proper fronds at runtime (src/components/GrovePlants.tsx, PalmPlant); palms belong on that path, placed by the scene, not baked into the model.
